events.verdict: Castle (SAS) briefly rests his hands on Russell's (LAL) back and marginal contact occurs as he releases away from the defender.
James (LAL) jumps straight up into the air and absorbs the marginal contact with Castle (SAS) while avoiding making any illegal arm contact during the driving shot attempt.
Reaves (LAL) jumps vertically into the air and avoids making any illegal contact with Castle (SAS) during the driving shot attempt.
James (LAL) and Johnson (SAS) come together while they move along the perimeter, the off-ball contact is consider marginal .
Johnson (SAS) brings his hands forward and marginal brush contact occurs with Davis' (LAL) lower body as he elevates for the dunk attempt at the basket.
Wembanyama (SAS) brings his arm towards the ball and avoids making any illegal contact with Davis (LAL) during his contest of Davis' dunk attempt at the basket.
Wembanyama (SAS) establishes himself in Russell's (LAL) path and does not deliver any illegal contact when setting the pick.
Russell (LAL) momentarily rests his hand on Wembanyama's (SAS) side and the contact during the jump shot attempt is marginal.
James (LAL) releases his pass and then firms up in a screening position in front of Wembanyama (SAS), absorbing the marginal contact with Wembanyama as the defender moves around the pick.
Paul (SAS) releases his pass and then shifts to his left and into Davis (LAL), delivering contact that dislodges the defender during Paul's attempt to set a pick.
Russell (LAL) firms up in Wembanyama's (SAS) path and marginal contact occurs as the two players come together during the screen.
Johnson (SAS) legally contests James' (LAL) layup attempt at the basket.
Castle (SAS) maintains legal positioning in the court of play while in possession of the ball.
Reaves (LAL) closes out to the space in front of Castle (SAS) and marginal lower body contact occurs with Castle's partially extended right leg after the release of the jump shot attempt.
Castle's (SAS) right leg extends slightly outward after the release of his jump shot attempt and the ensuing lower body contact with Reaves (LAL) is marginal.
Johnson (SAS) and James (LAL) make simultaneous contact with the ball and incidental arm contact occurs as both players attempt to gain complete control of the rebound.
Paul (SAS) commits a take foul on James (LAL).
Paul (SAS) releases his pass and his arms brush Reddish's (LAL) side as he cuts away from the ball. The contact with Reddish is marginal.
Reddish (LAL) legally contests Vassell's (SAS) jump shot attempt.
Castle's (SAS) left hand comes down as he launches up towards the loose ball and marginal contact occurs with James (LAL) during the rebounding opportunity.
